extracted.name: Granny Mabel's Best Bar Cookies
extracted.description: These irresistible bar cookies layer oats, chocolate chips, and caramel ice cream topping into one rich, chewy dessert that’s sure to become a favorite.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 ounce) jar caramel ice cream topping
instruction_lines: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13-inch pan.
Stir flour, oats, brown sugar, salt, and baking soda together in a large bowl. Mix in melted butter until evenly combined. Press half of the mixture into the bottom of the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until lightly toasted, about 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and immediately sprinkle with chocolate chips. Let stand until the chocolate chips soften slightly.
Mix caramel topping and flour together in a small bowl; drizzle evenly over the chocolate chips. Sprinkle the remaining crust mixture evenly over the caramel layer and press down lightly.
Bake for 15 more minutes in the preheated oven. Allow to cool completely before cutting into squares.
